title: HR Administrator
description:
Are you an experienced HR Administrator looking for your next opportunity within a busy, growing business?

SF Partners is working with a well-established and growing organisation in Lichfield to recruit an experienced HR Administrator on a 12-month fixed-term contract. You'll join an established HR team and play a key role in ensuring the smooth running of day-to-day HR operations. We're looking for someone who is confident in their HR administration experience, can quickly pick up processes and systems, and is comfortable managing a varied workload with minimal supervision.

Location: Lichfield
Salary: £32,000-£35,000
12 month FTC - Hybrid working - 3 days office 2 days home

Key Responsibilities
- Manage HR administration across the employee lifecycle, including contracts, offer letters, employee changes and leaver documentation.
- Maintain accurate employee records and update the HR system, ensuring compliance with GDPR requirements.
- Coordinate onboarding and offboarding processes, including inductions and exit documentation.
- Support payroll administration by providing accurate employee information and processing changes.
- Assist with employee benefits administration, including enrolments and amendments.
- Act as a first point of contact for HR queries, providing guidance on policies and procedures.
- Provide administrative support with employee relations matters, including disciplinaries and grievances.
- Produce HR reports covering headcount, absence and employee turnover.
- Support HR projects, employee engagement activities and training initiatives.
- Ensure HR processes and documentation are accurate, organised and compliant.

About You

We're particularly interested in speaking with candidates who have:
- Strong, proven HR administration experience within a busy HR environment.
- Experience managing the full employee lifecycle.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Confidence using HR systems and Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
- The ability to manage competing priorities and work independently.
- Strong communication skills and a professional, approachable manner.
- A proactive attitude, with the confidence to take ownership of their workload.
- Experience supporting payroll, benefits administration and employee relations processes would be advantageous.

This opportunity would suit an established HR Administrator or HR Coordinator who enjoys being hands-on, thrives in a busy environment and can quickly become a valued member of the team.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary of £32,000-£35,000.
- Hybrid working - 3 days in the office and 2 days from home.
- 12-month fixed-term contract with potential for a permanent opportunity.
- Opportunity to join a growing organisation with approximately 1,100 employees.
- Established and supportive HR team.
- A varied role offering exposure to the full employee lifecycle.

title: HR Administrator
description:
HR Administrator

Location: Rugeley (WS15)

Hours: 25-30 hours per week (flexible)

Pay: Up to 14.30 per hour

Working arrangements: Hybrid

Want to grow your career while maintaining work-life balance?

We're working with a well-established specialist contractor delivering sustainable infrastructure solutions across Britain looking for an experienced HR Administrator to join the team.

You'll provide day-to-day HR support across the business, helping with everything from recruitment and onboarding through to employee records, payroll support and training.

What you'll be doing
- Supporting recruitment, onboarding and pre-employment checks.
- Preparing job adverts, offer letters and employment contracts.
- Maintaining accurate and confidential employee records.
- Updating HR systems, including BrightHR and TimeKeeper.
- Managing training records and arranging employee training.
- Supporting payroll with timesheets, absences and contractual changes.
- Acting as a first point of contact for general HR queries.
- Supporting employees with policies, holiday entitlement and HR procedures.
- Ensuring HR records are accurate and GDPR compliant.
- Providing general HR administration support to the wider business.

What we're looking for
- PreviousHR administration experience is essential.
- CIPD Level 3/4 qualified or currently working towards a qualification.
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel.
- Experience using HR systems or databases.
- Excellent attention to detail and organisation.
- Confident communication skills.
- A professional and discreet approach when handling confidential information.
- GCSEs (or equivalent) in English and Maths.

What's on offer?
- Up to 14.30 for 25 to 30 hours
- 25-30 hours per week, ideally across 5 days.
- Flexible hours (potentially ideal for school hours).
- 1 day per week working from home.
- CIPD training support available, with the company able to cover training costs subject to its training policy.
- Opportunity to develop your HR career within a growing business.
- Supportive team environment.
- Pension scheme with auto-enrolment.

If you're an experienced HR Administrator looking for a flexible role where you can continue developing your HR career, apply today!

title: HR Coordinator
description:
SF Partners are currently recruiting for an experienced HR Coordinator to join a busy HR team within a well-established organisation based in Tamworth. This is a permanent opportunity and would suit someone who enjoys taking ownership of end-to-end HR administration and wants to work in a varied, hands-on role where no two days are the same.

Tamworth £30,000 - £35, hours per week Monday Friday, Site Based.

You will work closely with the wider HR team, providing comprehensive administrative support across the full employee lifecycle.

The Role

Providing end-to-end HR administration across the employee lifecycle
Preparing offer letters, contracts and other HR documentation
Coordinating new starters and onboarding
Monitoring probationary periods and supporting associated administration
Maintaining accurate employee records across multiple HR systems
Updating HR spreadsheets, trackers and reports
Responding to day-to-day employee and manager HR queries
Supporting recruitment and general HR activities
Providing some payroll administration and input during a period of transition to an outsourced payroll provider
Ensuring employee data is accurate, confidential and up to date
Providing wider administrative support to the HR team as required

We are looking for someone with previous HR administration experience who is comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and managing a varied workload.

You will ideally have:

Previous experience within an HR Administrator, HR Assistant or similar role
Good knowledge of the employee lifecycle
Experience preparing HR documentation and maintaining employee records
Strong Excel and systems skills
Excellent attention to detail
Confidence working across multiple systems and data sources
A proactive, organised and flexible approach
The ability to work independently while being part of a small HR team

Apply today

title: HR Coordinator (human Resources Coordinator)
description:
Job Title: HR Coordinator

Reporting to: Managing Director (line management); Fractional HRD (functional reporting)

Salary: £30,000 to £35,000per annum

Contract type: Full time or Part time (phone number removed) FTE)

About the Role

Provide day-to-day transactional HR and internal recruitment support to a fast-growing, founder-led business of around 60 people. This is a hands-on role covering internal recruitment coordination, onboarding, HR administration, and first-line employee queries giving one person a broad view across the employee lifecycle while the organisation continues to scale.

There is genuine scope for the right person to grow with the business, potentially progressing towards a more specialist or advisory HR or talent role as the function develops.

Key Responsibilities

Internal Recruitment support
- Coordinate recruitment activity end-to-end: posting roles, screening applications, scheduling interviews, and liaising with hiring managers and candidates
- Support the offer and pre-employment check process (references, right-to-work, contracts)
- Help maintain a positive candidate experience as the business scales its hiring

Onboarding
- Own the new starter process: inductions, paperwork, system access requests, and first-week check-ins
- Continuously improve onboarding materials as the business and roles evolve

HR administration & data
- Maintain accurate, compliant HR files (physical and digital) for all employees
- Manage and update HR data/HRIS, ensuring records are current for headcount, absence, and reporting purposes
- Support production of routine HR reports and metrics

First-line HR support
- Act as the first point of contact for day-to-day employee queries (holiday, policies, benefits), escalating more complex matters appropriately
- Signpost employees to relevant policies and self-service resources
- Help maintain and update the policy library as things change

General
- Provide flexible support across HR and, where needed, adjacent functions as priorities shift
- Contribute ideas for improving processes as the organisation grows much of what this role covers will evolve over time
- Other tasks which may be reasonably required from time to time

What Working Here Is Like:
- Priorities can shift quickly you might be sourcing candidates one day and updating HR systems the next
- Processes are still being built in places, so you'll sometimes be working things out as you go rather than following an established playbook
- Investment-backed and founder-led, so pace and visibility are both high decisions get made fast

title: Recruitment Administrator
description:
Recruitment Administrator Office-based in Stoke on Trent Monday to Friday, 9:30am to 2:30pm (flexible) 15 per hour Structured hours with strong work-life balance in a busy recruitment environment

Meridian Business Support are looking to appoint a Recruitment Administrator to support day-to-day operations within a well established branch. This position plays a key part in ensuring payroll accuracy and smooth onboarding for a large candidate workforce.

As a Recruitment Administrator, you will be responsible for maintaining accurate records and delivering timely payroll processing within a fast-moving environment:
- Process weekly payroll, ensuring deadlines are consistently met
- Collate, check and verify timesheets with a high level of accuracy
- Calculate holiday pay, overtime, bonuses and adjustments using Excel and internal systems
- Maintain and update candidate records within the CRM system
- Enter new starters and ensure all personal and assignment data is recorded correctly
- Issue assignment details, contracts and relevant onboarding documentation to candidates
- Answer the phone, and responding to queries from both candidates and clients

To be successful in this Recruitment Administrator role, you will demonstrate:
- Excellent communication skills including via the phone and email
- Strong Excel skills, including confidence with calculations and data management
- Previous experience using CRM systems or recruitment databases
- Excellent attention to detail with a focus on accuracy and compliance
- Ability to manage high-volume administrative tasks and meet strict deadlines
- Experience within payroll, recruitment administration or a similar coordination role is desirable

Benefits and working environment
- 15 per hour
- Consistent weekday hours with no weekend work
- Office-based role offering structure and routine
- Supportive and collaborative team environment
- Possible Opportunity to develop within a growing recruitment business

If you are a detail-focused administrator looking for a busy and structured position where your organisational and Excel skills will be valued, this Recruitment Administrator position offers a stable and rewarding next step.

Meridian Business Support is a recruitment specialist acting on behalf of our client as an Employment Agency for this vacancy.

title: Recruitment Coordinator
description:
